name: Thats My Echo
tagline: A platformer where you leave echoes that replay your moves, and the enemy hunts only the echoes.

awards: [MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry

problem: The team wanted a fresh puzzle mechanic.
solution: A Unity game where recorded echoes interact with the level and lure a listening enemy.
demo_moment: Team-described: use an echo to distract the enemy.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry” among 223 submissions.

lessons: One clever mechanic carries a game.
